::: {#exr-zero-or-one}

#### A feature for 0 or 1

Using the 0s and 1s in @fig-digits-grid,
write a [feature](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature):
one number, computed from an image's 64 pixels,
that tends to be small for a 0 and large for a 1.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint
Where does a 0 have no ink?
